title: Among cards that are legal in the 'commander' format and have unknown power
question: Among cards that are legal in the 'commander' format and have unknown power (either NULL or '*'), find those that belong to sets released exclusively outside Magic: The Gathering Online and are not available in foil. Return the count of such cards per set name.

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    T2."XCL_110" AS set_name,
    COUNT(T1."XCL_001") AS card_count
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN legalities AS T3
    ON T1."XCL_072" = T3."XCL_086"
INNER JOIN sets AS T2
    ON T1."XCL_063" = T2."XCL_099"
WHERE
    T3."XCL_084" = 'commander'
    AND T3."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
    AND (T1."XCL_055" IS NULL OR T1."XCL_055" = '*')
    AND T1."XCL_004" NOT LIKE '%mtgo%'
    AND T1."XCL_006" IS NULL
GROUP BY T2."XCL_110"

SELECT "__ontology_entity_grain"."__grain_value_0" AS set_name, COUNT("__ontology_entity_grain"."__grain_value_1") AS card_count FROM (SELECT DISTINCT T2."XCL_110" AS "__grain_value_0", T1."XCL_001" AS "__grain_value_1" FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T3 ON T1."XCL_072" = T3."XCL_086" INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T1."XCL_063" = T2."XCL_099" WHERE T3."XCL_084" = 'commander' AND T3."XCL_085" = 'Legal' AND (T1."XCL_055" IS NULL OR T1."XCL_055" = '*') AND T1."XCL_004" NOT LIKE '%mtgo%' AND T1."XCL_006" IS NULL) AS __ontology_entity_grain GROUP BY "__ontology_entity_grain"."__grain_value_0"

SELECT
    T2."XCL_110" AS set_name,
    COUNT(T1."XCL_001") AS card_count
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN legalities AS T3
    ON T1."XCL_072" = T3."XCL_086"
INNER JOIN sets AS T2
    ON T1."XCL_063" = T2."XCL_099"
WHERE
    T3."XCL_084" = 'commander'
    AND T3."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
    AND (T1."XCL_055" IS NULL OR T1."XCL_055" = '*')
    AND T1."XCL_004" NOT LIKE '%mtgo%'
    AND T1."XCL_006" IS NULL
GROUP BY T2."XCL_110"
